pages.text: PLANNED FEATURE — not implemented in this patch. Discover a small entrance ruin on Overworld land, with entrances targeting roughly 250 blocks apart. The proposed separate Mini Temple dimension has three floors of 5 by 5 modules, using regular Temple room templates.
Mini Temple treasure will be capped at Tier 2. Sentinel Ominous Stones are planned to have a very rare chance of yielding a Shard of Divinity. The exact chance and entry behavior are not finalized.
